name: mnote_update_page
description: Update a page by `slug` in a notebook (`notebook` slug). Only the fields you send change: `title`, `body` (markdown — REPLACES the whole body, so fetch with mnote_get_page and resend the full new markdown to append/edit), `parent` (a page slug to re-nest under; empty string "" moves it to the root), `position` (order among siblings). Requires the notes:write scope (403 otherwise). Returns the updated page.

body.description: New full markdown body (replaces the old).

parent.description: New parent page slug, or "" for root.
